statement.p: Find the volume under the graph of the function f(x,y) = 8 x^2 y over the region shown in the figure below.

static.solution: x = 3, x = 8, y = 9, and y = 3 x. Thus \mbox{vol } = \int_{3}^{8}\int_{9}^{3 x} 8 x^2 y\,dy\,dx. To evaluate this integral, we evaluate the inside integral first: \int_{9}^{3 x} 8 x^2 y\,dy = 4 x^2 y^2\bigg|_{9}^{3 x} = 4 (9 x^4 - 81 x^2). Therefore, we have \int_{3}^{8} \int_{9}^{3 x} 8 x^2y\, dy\, dx = \int_{3}^{8} (36 x^4 - 324 x^2)\,dx = \left(\frac{36}{5} x^5 - 108 x^3\right)\bigg|_{3}^{8} = 181800. The volume of this object is 181800.
